manuscript: Columbia University, Rare Book & Manuscript Library, MS Or 320 - FOLIO (Vendidad Sade, Surat, 1131 AY = 1762 CE)
images: OPenn web JPEGs, https://openn.library.upenn.edu/Data/0032/ms_or_320/data/web/9574_NNNN_web.jpg (NNNN = image index in the TEI)
rule: Chapter boundaries from the Persian verse headings read on the images. Page starts inside a fargard were not accepted because the Avestan opening words could not be confirmed on the images; each fargard is therefore one section listing all its pages.

readings.reading: 2 red Avestan lines; 4 lines of Persian verse: 'که وندیداد نامش' (whose name is Vendidad), 'کز آن ورگرد اول' (of it, the first fargard); red line with rosettes; then 10 black Avestan lines = start of Fargard 1

lines 1-4 Avestan, line 4 closing with red words and a rosette = end of Fargard 1; row of rosettes; 3 red Persian lines: 'به ورگرد دویم بدان ای عزیز / که احوال جمشید گفته ست نیز' (know the second fargard, which tells the story of Jamshid); red line with rosettes; 8 Avestan lines = start of Fargard 2

Avestan lines ending with red formula and rosettes = end of Fargard 2; row of rosettes; 3 lines of Persian verse whose first line names the third fargard ('سیوم'); red Avestan line with rosettes and the numeral 3
Persian heading with red numeral 4 (fourth fargard); not used
Persian heading with red numeral 5 (fifth fargard); not used
Persian heading naming the sixth fargard; not used

not_accepted: Per-page opening words of fol. 60v-63r and 64r-71r were compared with renderings of Geldner's text in the Noto Sans Avestan font; the match could not be confirmed with certainty, so no page start inside a fargard is used.
